note: 0.5 dev.19 (Osama, 6 November 2026). The Tigr Kornet 2x4 Kornet upgrade (option 433) is its own card at 120, in the Motorized Infantry specialization (9) only. Its two Kornet x4 launchers ripple fire: 2 missiles per burst and 2 guided at once (a copy of weapon 214 with the vanilla values), so other Kornet launchers keep 1 missile per target. Tigr Kornet keeps the Kornet-M loadout at 80. Availability 4, copied from Tigr Kornet. Not yet run in a game.
